reserveReview.rationale: Fresh capture from the issuer-run reserve API on 2026-09-04 reported $19,855,565.93014987 of collateral; companion overview timestamp 2026-09-04T17:48:54.371Z. Grouping the 17 chain-level positions by stablecoin family yields AUSD 25.2901331784%, sUSDS 23.6406111204%, CELO 19.8880648425%, USDT/USDT0 11.1910668211%, EUROP 5.8495797572%, EURC/axlEUROC 5.7192251470%, USDC/axlUSDC 4.2423024173%, stETH 3.1196575688%, and ETH/WETH 1.0593591473%, normalized to 100%; WBTC is a zero-weight dust row and is omitted. Each tracked stablecoin exposure has an exact collateral edge; CELO, stETH, and ETH remain explicit exogenous collateral. The September 4 curated parent-family shares remain on the proof-of-reserves period-end basis. September 30 verified representation identities are keyed zero-percent classification rows for new live slices; their zero authored weights do not assert historical absence or a September 4 native/bridge split. New live observations supply independently measured representation weights and remain subject to normal evidence admission.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Historical parent-family holdings are identified, but the September 4 native-versus-bridge split is not independently reconstructed.
